seal.statement: A native Raft group that accepts an exact, durable-identity inbound envelope as CORE_OK/inbound-enqueued must own the bounded scheduled drain as admitted work, even when no unrelated event-loop handle remains. Every admitted envelope either reaches the real lifecycle-admitted core/Ready/application/publication path, or stays as explicitly owned and typed deferred debt; it cannot disappear on idle-process exit. Close and replacement retire its exact scheduling resources without leaving referenced background work.
